dialogue.text: “<player's name>! You’ve cracked every clue! I always knew you were secretly… a genius in disguise. Possibly disguised as a genius.”
“Disguised or not, <player's name> just solved everything. Meanwhile, you’re still trying to interrogate a tree.”
“<player's name>! You were magnificent — just shy of perfection! If only you’d listened to my brilliant theories about the hedges.”
“If <player's name> had listened to you, we’d still be questioning the birdbath. Good work, <player's name>.”
“<player's name>, you sniffed out most of the trail! You’re practically honorary cow-detective now.”
“They did well, Moo. But let’s not pretend a cow has ever solved anything.”
“Ah, <player's name> — you stumbled, you fumbled, but you made it here in the end! That’s the spirit of a true… confused champion.”
“You mean ‘determined’. Though ‘confused’ fits too. Well done anyway, <player's name>.”
“Well… <player's name>… you did catch some clues. Which is more than I can say for Hazel when she tried to catch her own tail.”
“Unlike you, <player's name> actually helped — even if they did accuse a flowerpot at one point.”
“Oh dear. <player's name>, you appear to have been… heroically lost the entire time. Admirable commitment to wandering aimlessly!”
“At least <player's name> didn’t try to arrest the sun like you did, Moo. Progress.”
“Ah, <player's name>. Clearly saving your energy for… the next case. A bold tactic.”
“Or maybe just asleep the whole time, like you during stakeouts, Moo. Better luck next time, <player's name>.”
